<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Legislative update:</strong> Parliament has officially passed the Transgender Persons (Protection of Rights) Amendment Bill, 2026, following its approval in the Rajya Sabha.</li>
  <li><strong>Economic policy shift:</strong> A $133 billion liquidity surge has prompted the Reserve Bank of India to adopt a more hawkish monetary policy stance to manage inflationary pressures.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W1</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Election Commission oversight:</strong> Amidst ongoing political protests and calls for the removal of the CEC, the Supreme Court is set to hear a petition questioning the decision-making processes and alleged lack of dissent within the Election Commission.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W4</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W9</a></span></li>
